name: Jawad Zafar Estimates – Proposals for Contractors
author: Jawad Zafar

sections.description:
Jawad Zafar Estimates lets a contractor price a job, send a branded proposal, get it signed online and track the deposit and stage payments, all from their own WordPress site. No monthly subscription and no client logins.

Estimating

  • Cost library of materials, labour, equipment and subcontract items, with CSV import and export.
  • Line items with sections, quantity, unit, unit cost, waste % and markup.
  • Quantity calculator for area, perimeter and concrete volume, in metric or imperial units.
  • Overhead, contingency, import duty, freight, fees, discount and tax (VAT, GST or sales tax), added on top or included in prices.
  • Live totals, plus direct cost, gross profit and margin that only you can see.
  • Optional upgrades your client can tick on the proposal.
  • Automatic versions: once a proposal is sent, every real change becomes a new version.

Proposals and e-signature

  • A private link for each proposal. It works on phones and computers, and the client doesn’t need an account.
  • Branded page with your logo, colour, scope of work, pricing, payment schedule and terms.
  • The client ticks optional upgrades and the total updates straight away.
  • The client signs by drawing or typing their name. Name, date, time and IP address are recorded.
  • The client can request changes or decline, with a comment.
  • Print or save as PDF from the browser.
  • Your costs and markups are never sent to the client’s browser.

Payments

  • Deposit (percentage or fixed amount) and a payment schedule by stage.
  • Your bank transfer, cheque or cash instructions shown on the proposal.
  • Record payments as they arrive and see what’s paid and what’s due at each stage.

Works in your country

  • Setup wizard with presets for the UK, Ireland, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, The Bahamas, Cayman Islands, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, Barbados, UAE, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, India and Pakistan: currency, tax name and rate, tax-inclusive pricing and units in one step.
  • Sample cost items in metric or imperial units, priced roughly in your currency.

Email that reaches the inbox

  • HTML emails with a plain-text version and a “Review and sign” button.
  • Optional SMTP with presets for Gmail / Google Workspace, Outlook / Microsoft 365, Zoho, Brevo, SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES, Hostinger, cPanel hosting email and Namecheap Private Email.
  • SMTP can apply to this plugin’s emails only, so it never conflicts with another SMTP plugin.
  • Inbox check: shows whether your From address, SMTP, SPF, DKIM and DMARC are set up.
  • Send a test email and see a plain-language explanation of any error.

Logs and demo data

  • Activity log of everything in the plugin, with filters and CSV export.
  • Email log with delivery status, error details and one-click resend.
  • One-click demo data: 6 clients and 6 proposals at every stage, so you can see how it all works. Remove it again in one click.

Pro version

Everything above is free and has no limits. Jawad Zafar Estimates Pro adds Modern and Minimal proposal designs, bundled fonts, online deposit payment with Stripe, automatic follow-up emails, PDF attachments, estimate templates and photos on proposals.

External services

Jawad Zafar Estimates does not connect to any external service by default and does not collect usage data. It only connects to the services below when you set them up yourself.

Your SMTP email service (optional)

If you turn on SMTP in Estimates → Settings → Email & SMTP, the plugin’s emails are sent through the SMTP server you choose, instead of your web server’s own mail function. This is used to deliver proposal emails, signed copies and notifications so they reach the inbox.

What is sent, and when: each time the plugin sends an email (when you email a proposal, when a client signs, when a notification goes out, or when you send a test email), it connects to that SMTP server with the username and password you entered and sends the email: sender and recipient addresses, subject and message (which includes the client’s name, the proposal title, total and a link to it). Nothing is sent if SMTP is off.

The settings screen offers presets that fill in the server address for these providers. You only connect to the one you pick:

  • Gmail / Google Workspace (smtp.gmail.com), by Google: Terms, Privacy Policy
  • Outlook / Microsoft 365 (smtp.office365.com), by Microsoft: Services Agreement, Privacy Statement
  • Zoho Mail (smtp.zoho.com), by Zoho: Terms, Privacy Policy
  • Brevo (smtp-relay.brevo.com), by Brevo: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • SendGrid (smtp.sendgrid.net), by Twilio: Terms of Service, Privacy Notice
  • Mailgun (smtp.mailgun.org), by Mailgun: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
  • Amazon SES (email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, or your own region), by Amazon Web Services: Service Terms, Privacy Notice
  • Hostinger email (smtp.hostinger.com), by Hostinger: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
  • Namecheap Private Email (mail.privateemail.com), by Namecheap: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
  • Your hosting email (cPanel) and Custom: the mail server of your own hosting company or any server you enter. Its terms and privacy policy are those of your own provider.

DNS lookups (Inbox check)

When you open Estimates → Settings → Email & SMTP, the plugin looks up the public DNS records (SPF, DKIM and DMARC) of your own sending domain, using your server’s normal DNS resolver. Only your domain name is looked up. No data about you or your clients is sent.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Jawad Zafar Estimates”, then install and activate it. Or upload the ZIP in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. The setup wizard opens. Choose your country to set currency, tax and units.
  3. Go to Estimates → Settings and add your company details, logo and brand colour.
  4. Go to Estimates → Cost library and add items, import a CSV, or load the sample items.
  5. Add a client, then click New estimate.

Want to look around first? Go to Estimates → Settings → Demo data → Load demo data.

If a client link shows “page not found”, go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save once.
sections.faq:
Do my clients need an account?

No. Each proposal has a private link. Clients open it, choose options and sign. No login needed.

Can my client see my costs or markup?

No. The client page only receives selling prices. You can include overhead and contingency in line prices or show them as separate totals.

Does it take card payments?

The free version shows the deposit due and your payment instructions, and lets you record payments by bank transfer, cheque or cash. Online deposit payment with Stripe is in the Pro version.

Can I change how the proposal looks?

Set your logo and brand colour in Estimates → Settings. Developers can copy templates/proposal.php to your-theme/jawad-zafar-estimates/proposal.php and edit it there. The Pro version adds Modern and Minimal designs and font choices.

Emails are not arriving or go to spam

Go to Estimates → Settings → Email & SMTP. Set a From address on your own domain, connect SMTP and look at the Inbox check, which tells you what to fix. Estimates → Logs → Emails shows whether each email was sent and why any failed.

I already use WP Mail SMTP (or a similar plugin)

Leave this plugin’s SMTP off, or set it to “Only this plugin’s emails”. It won’t change how the rest of your site sends email.

Is the e-signature legally binding?

The plugin records the signer’s typed name, drawn or typed signature, date, time and IP address, and the client ticks an agreement box. Whether that is enough for your contracts depends on the law where you work. Ask a local lawyer if you’re unsure.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Nothing is deleted unless you turn on “Delete all data when the plugin is deleted” in Estimates → Settings.
